name: MA2CCI
summary: This EA uses a dual moving average crossover combined with a CCI zero-line cross to generate trend-following entry signals. ATR is used for dynamic stop loss placement, and lot sizing is based on either fixed lots or risk-based percentage of free margin with a drawdown reduction mechanism. Positions are closed on the opposite MA crossover signal.
summary_zh: 该EA使用双均线交叉结合CCI零线穿越产生趋势跟踪入场信号。ATR用于动态止损设置，手数基于固定手数或自由保证金风险比例，并包含亏损后减仓机制。当均线反向交叉时平仓。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于双均线交叉与CCI指标的组合确认：快速MA上穿慢速MA且CCI上穿零线时做多，快速MA下穿慢速MA且CCI下穿零线时做空。入场条件要求均线交叉和CCI穿越零线同时发生，双重过滤减少了假信号。出场条件为均线反向交叉时平仓，不设止盈，仅依赖ATR动态止损控制风险。仓位管理支持两种模式：固定手数或基于账户自由保证金比例的风险手数。资金管理包含亏损递减机制（DcF参数），连续亏损后自动缩减手数，但该机制仅在DcF>0时生效。止损基于ATR值计算，并检查是否满足经纪商最小止损水平要求，不满足时不开仓。整体策略属于典型的趋势跟踪系统，用CCI过滤均线交叉信号以减少震荡市中的虚假交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a dual moving average crossover confirmed by CCI zero-line crosses: a buy signal occurs when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and CCI crosses above zero simultaneously, while a sell signal requires the fast MA crossing below the slow MA with CCI crossing below zero. Entry conditions demand both the MA crossover and CCI zero-line cross to align, providing a dual filter that reduces false signals in ranging markets. Exit conditions rely on the opposite MA crossover to close positions, with no take-profit level set, depending solely on ATR-based dynamic stop loss for risk control. Position sizing supports two modes: fixed lot size or risk-based lot calculation using a percentage of free margin. Money management includes a drawdown reduction mechanism via the DcF parameter, which progressively decreases lot size after consecutive losses, but only activates when DcF is greater than zero. Stop loss is calculated from the ATR value and validated against the broker's minimum stop level, with orders rejected if the stop loss would be too close. Overall, this is a classic trend-following system that uses CCI to filter MA crossover signals and reduce whipsaw trades in sideways markets.

parameters.name: pATR
parameters.description_en: ATR indicator period for stop loss distance calculation

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description: 固定交易手数，为0时使用风险比例计算
parameters.description_en: Order lot size; 0 uses MaxR for dynamic calculation

parameters.name: SndMl
parameters.description: 是否在开仓和平仓时发送邮件通知
parameters.description_en: Send email notification on open and close

parameters.name: DcF
parameters.description: 亏损后手数递减系数，值越小减仓幅度越大，为0时不减仓
parameters.description_en: Lot decrease factor on loss; smaller = larger decrease, 0 = disabled

parameters.name: MaxR
parameters.description: 最大风险比例(0-1)，仅当Lots为0时生效
parameters.description_en: Max risk ratio (0-1) of available funds, used when Lots is 0

pros: 双重信号过滤（均线交叉+CCI确认）减少了震荡行情中的虚假信号
ATR动态止损适应市场波动率变化，比固定止损更合理
亏损递减机制（DcF参数）在连亏时自动减仓，有助于控制回撤
新K线检测机制（LastTime）避免同一根K线内重复交易
止损水平检查确保不违反经纪商最小止损距离要求
pros_en: Dual signal filtering (MA crossover + CCI confirmation) reduces false signals in ranging markets
ATR-based dynamic stop loss adapts to market volatility changes, more rational than fixed stops
Drawdown reduction mechanism (DcF parameter) automatically decreases lot size after consecutive losses
New bar detection via LastTime prevents multiple trades within the same bar
Stop level validation ensures orders comply with broker minimum stop distance requirements
cons: 均线和CCI周期均极短（默认4/8/4），容易产生频繁的虚假信号和过度交易
没有止盈设置，盈利完全依赖止损或反向信号平仓，可能错失最佳出场点
仓位检查仅针对当前品种，不支持多品种同时运行时的全局风险控制
邮件通知使用SendMail但仅简单检查错误，缺乏重试或备用通知机制
亏损递减机制公式（aLots-aLots*losses/DcF）在连续亏损较多时可能将手数减至极小值
cons_en: Extremely short MA and CCI periods (default 4/8/4) lead to frequent false signals and overtrading
No take-profit level means profits depend entirely on stop loss or opposing signal exits, potentially missing optimal exit points
Position check is per-symbol only, lacking global risk control for multi-symbol concurrent operation
Email notification uses SendMail with only basic error checking, lacking retry or fallback notification mechanisms
The lot reduction formula (aLots-aLots*losses/DcF) can reduce lot size to extremely small values after many consecutive losses
improvements: 增加止盈参数或移动止盈机制，锁定利润并优化盈亏比
增加交易时间过滤和点差过滤，避免在不适合的时段和高点差环境下交易
增加最大回撤限制和最大连续亏损次数限制，作为硬性风控底线
优化参数默认值，4/8周期的均线和CCI过于敏感，建议提供更稳健的默认值如10/20/14
improvements_en: Add take-profit parameter or trailing stop mechanism to lock in profits and optimize risk-reward ratio
Add trading session filter and spread filter to avoid trading during unfavorable hours or high-spread conditions
Add maximum drawdown limit and maximum consecutive loss count limit as hard risk control floors
Optimize default parameter values — 4/8 period MAs and CCI are overly sensitive; consider more robust defaults like 10/20/14

risk_points: 极短周期的均线和CCI参数导致信号频繁且可靠性低，增加过度交易风险
无止盈机制，盈利交易可能因等待反向信号而大幅回吐
亏损递减机制在DcF=0时完全失效，此时无任何连亏保护
仅检查单品种持仓，无全局持仓和风险控制
risk_points_en: Extremely short-period MA and CCI parameters generate frequent and unreliable signals, increasing overtrading risk
No take-profit mechanism means winning trades may give back significant gains while waiting for opposing signals
Drawdown reduction mechanism is completely disabled when DcF=0, providing no consecutive-loss protection
Only checks single-symbol positions without global position or risk control
